crossRefs.note: I was mute with silence. I held my peace, even from good. My sorrow was stirred.
I was mute. I didn’t open my mouth, because you did it.
The king said, “What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah? Because he curses, and because Yahweh has said to him…
He was oppressed, yet when he was afflicted he didn’t open his mouth. As a lamb that is led to the slaughter, and as a…
When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back. When he suffered, he didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges…

translations.web: But I, as a deaf man, don’t hear. I am as a mute man who doesn’t open his mouth.
translations.bsb: But like a deaf man, I do not hear; and like a mute man, I do not open my mouth.
translations.kjv: But I, as a deaf man, heard not; and I was as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.
translations.asv: But I, as a deaf man, hear not; And I am as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.
